about.title: About Statsify
about.whatText: Statsify shows Hypixel stats as images in Discord and as pages on this site. Look up a player, then open any game for every stat it tracks.
about.linksText: Every stat with a leaderboard links to it: a player's <chip/> opens the FKDR leaderboard at their rank. What each stat means is in the <glossary>Stat Glossary</glossary>.
about.contactText: Help is on Discord. Everything else goes by email, so there's a written record.
about.statsText: Stats come from Hypixel's public API. A player's page shows their stats from the last time anyone looked them up, and Refresh fetches new ones.
about.leaderboardsNote: Leaderboards only include players someone has looked up on Statsify, so a rank is among those players, not everyone on Hypixel.
about.namesText: Names and skins come from Mojang, and change when the player changes them.
about.sourceText: The bot and this site are open source under the GNU AGPL v3 or later. The code is <github>on GitHub</github>.

glossary.title: Stat Glossary
glossary.intro: What each stat on Statsify means, how the ratios are worked out, and which games show it. The labels are the ones on the bot's cards.
glossary.levels: BedWars levels and their colors are on the <prestiges>BedWars Prestiges</prestiges> page.
glossary.noMatches: No stats match "{{query}}". Try fewer letters, or clear the box.

prestiges.title: BedWars Prestiges
prestiges.intro: Every BedWars prestige up to {{top}} stars, in the colors its level shows in game. A prestige is 100 levels and takes {{exp}} EXP.
prestiges.levels: The first levels of each prestige are quicker ({{first}} EXP); every level after them takes {{steady}}.
prestiges.noteText: Hypixel sells other prestige colors, stars and brackets, so a player's level can look different from its prestige here.
